findings.title: API key is expected in the X-API-Key header
findings.documented: The API documentation describes the API key as a query parameter.
findings.actual: The running API requires X-API-Key in the request header.
findings.how_found: Calling the authentication endpoint with the documented query-parameter form returned 401; retrying with X-API-Key header succeeded.
findings.impact: Clients following the documentation literally fail authentication.

findings.title: Login response contains undocumented session fields
findings.documented: The documented login contract does not describe the complete access and refresh token response observed from the running API.
findings.actual: The running API returns access_token, refresh_token, token_type, expires_in, refresh_url and user.
findings.how_found: Called POST /auth/login with valid credentials and inspected the response.
findings.impact: The frontend must use the actual token response to maintain an authenticated session.

findings.title: Offset pagination works while page pagination does not advance results
findings.actual: Changing page did not advance the returned records; offset-based retrieval returned subsequent records.
findings.how_found: Compared requests using page=2 and offset-based requests.
findings.impact: A client implementing page pagination exactly as documented can repeatedly retrieve the same records.

findings.title: Reported listing total is lower than the records retrievable from the endpoint
findings.documented: The endpoint reports a total record count for the listings collection.
findings.actual: The API reported 3,236 records while complete offset retrieval produced 3,500 distinct listing IDs.
findings.how_found: Paginated through the listings endpoint using offset until has_more was false and counted distinct listing IDs.
findings.impact: The reported total cannot be used as the authoritative dataset size.

findings.title: Project price fields use inconsistent numeric scales
findings.documented: Project prices are described as INR values.
findings.actual: Observed values require lakh/crore-style normalization to compare projects correctly.
findings.how_found: Compared project price magnitudes against project names and surrounding dataset values and normalized the observed scales.
findings.impact: Sorting or comparing raw price_max values can produce materially incorrect results.

findings.title: Project total_listings values do not consistently match observed listing counts
findings.actual: 295 projects have total_listings values that differ from the counts derived from the retrieved listings.
findings.how_found: Grouped listings by project and compared those counts with each project's total_listings field.
findings.impact: Project-level inventory counts should not be blindly trusted as authoritative.

findings.title: 18 listing records contain objective data-quality violations
findings.documented: Listings are expected to contain valid listing attributes.
findings.actual: 18 records violate objective constraints used in the analysis.
findings.how_found: Applied validation checks to listing fields and identified impossible records.
findings.impact: These records were excluded from calculations that depend on valid listing data.

findings.title: 230 listings are suspicious fake-listing candidates
findings.documented: The listing contract does not provide a definitive fraud flag.
findings.actual: A seller-contact heuristic identified 230 candidate records associated with suspicious repeated contact patterns.
findings.how_found: Grouped listings by seller contact and flagged groups with repeated contact information combined with multiple seller names.
findings.impact: These candidates were excluded from the 2BHK price-per-square-foot analysis to reduce contamination from suspicious records.

findings.title: Documented analytics summary endpoint is unavailable
findings.documented: GET /v1/analytics/summary is documented as the analytics summary endpoint.
findings.actual: The running API returned HTTP 404 Not Found.
findings.how_found: Called the documented endpoint with a valid API key and authenticated access token.
findings.impact: The frontend cannot depend on the documented analytics endpoint and instead computes the analytics summary from the retrieved dataset.
